name: CCT 2026 Contenders Europe 8 - Open Qualifier 2
description:
Qualification: Top 8 teams will advance to the Main Event of CCT 2026 Contenders Europe 8.

Match Format: All matches will be played in Best-of-1 format.

Roster Locks: Rosters are locked at the start of the tournament; no changes allowed once competition begins. Teams that qualify must use the same starting five during CCT 2026 Contenders Europe 8.

Team Availability: Qualified teams must confirm full availability to participate according to the event schedule -  [Event Schedule](https://docs.google.com/spreadsheets/d/19HIMuPh06bOqFhtOTg9ujJofha_QXAaXTDT384YQSDI/edit?usp=sharing).

Eligibility Compliance:
- Players must not have active FACEIT game bans; otherwise, matches will not launch on the platform.
- All players must reside in Europe Region. Failure to comply may result in team disqualification.

Any team that qualifies through Open Qualifiers must be fully eligible to compete in the regional event, in line with Valve’s Tournament Operating Requirements and the CCT Rulebook. This includes:
- The core roster, for all matches, must currently reside in the region they are competing in.
- The core roster used to qualify (at least 3 of the 5 players) must be maintained for all starting matches of the regional event.
- Any changes to the qualified roster must be pre-approved by Tournament Officials.
Teams that don’t meet these requirements may be disqualified or replaced without further notice.

name: Galaxy Battle LAN-STATION 1 European Open Qualifier
description:
Welcome to the Galaxy Battle LAN-STATION 1 Open Qualifiers! 🌌
Your journey to the grand LAN Final in Portugal starts here. The winning team of this qualifier secures a direct slot into the closed Online Stage (Group Stage).

📌 Tournament Overview:

Bracket Format: Single-Elimination.

Match Format: All matches leading to the Grand Final are BO1. The Grand Final for the slot is BO3.

Regional Rule: This is the European Qualifier. The active roster for every match must contain a minimum of 3 players from Europe. Players from other regions with artificially high ping may be disqualified at the Admin's discretion.

Age Limit: 16+.

Anti-Cheat: FACEIT Anti-Cheat is strictly mandatory. You will not be able to join the server without it.

🔗 Support:
If you have any disputes with your opponent or face server issues, please contact our Head Admin immediately.

Head Admin Discord: comeblack_. Please include the link to your FACEIT match room in your direct message.

Prepare for a tough battle and show your best CS2. GL & HF! 🏆

name: IEM Beijing 2026 - Global Qualifier - EU Servers
description:
**Global Qualifier is open to participants from anywhere in the world; however, please note that all matches will be played exclusively on European servers**

- **Participants must be FACEIT Verified in order to compete**
- **Participants must be able to provide two operational webcam feeds upon request for competitive integrity checks. Failure to do so may result in disqualification**

Open Qualifier Provisional Schedule (Timezone CET):

Day 1
- Timeslot #1: 18:00 - Ro512 (256 matches) [Bo1]						
- Timeslot #2: 19:10 - Ro256 (128 matches) [Bo1]						
- Timeslot #3: 20:10 - Ro128 (64 matches) [Bo1]						
- Timeslot #4: 21:10 - Ro64 (32 matches) [Bo1]						
- Timeslot #5: 22:10 - Ro32 (16 matches) [Bo1]	

Day 2
- Timeslot #1: 18:00 - Ro16 (8 matches) [Bo1]						
- Timeslot #2: 19:10 - Deciders (4 matches) [Bo3]					


Open Qualifier Format: 

- One open qualifier for 4 slots						
- Unlimited SE best-of-one bracket						
- Decider matches Bo3						
- The qualifier determines four teams						

Closed Qualifier Format
					
- 16 Teams						
- DE best-of-three bracket						
- 12 invites & 4 qualifying from open qualifiers						
- Two teams advance to the main event						
- Date: 2 - 4 September

description:
The Open Qualifier for Stake Ranked Ep.4, the fourth tournament of the Tier 2 CS2 LAN circuit by Stake and StarLadder.
Teams will compete for 4 spots in the Closed Qualifier, where they will join VRS-invited rosters on the road to the LAN Finals.

name: Stake Pulse Beat II - Open Qualifier I
description:
Welcome to the Stake Pulse Beat II - Open Qualifier I, taking place on August 20, 2026. 

One team will qualify from this tournament to compete at the Stake Pulse Beat II Main Event — a $60,000 LAN tournament.

The qualifier follows a Single Elimination format with Best-of-One matches throughout, and a Best-of-Three Grand Final. All matches are played on Counter-Strike 2 using the Active Duty map pool.

Please note: teams that qualify through Open Qualifier I are not eligible to participate in Open Qualifier II (August 21).

Any team that has already successfully secured a spot at Stake Pulse Beat II through the registration system is not eligible to participate in either Open Qualifier. This rule has been further reinforced for Stake Pulse Beat II.

📋 Official Rulebook: https://docs.google.com/document/d/1GxACuasRb2YA8IEc2RYFr9ajOlYzajAMHKYxbI_cD0M/edit?usp=sharing

By registering, you confirm that you have read and accepted all rules outlined in the rulebook. All participants must have the FACEIT Anti-Cheat installed before the tournament begins.

For support, reach out via a ticket to the Tournament Discord (https://discord.gg/yyYDmjYkEM) or contact us at pulse@bme.nu.

name: CyberClash Open | Qualifier 3
description:
Learn more about tournament: https://github.com/cisesportsleague/CyberClash-Open
Rules of the Open Qualifiers: https://github.com/cisesportsleague/CyberClash-Open/blob/main/open-quals-rules.md

Top-2 Teams from each Qualifier advance to the Main event
Main Event Prize Pool: 25 495 USD
Main Event Group Stage: Best 8 teams from Open Qualifiers (Online - 26 - 28th of August 2026 - 2 GSL BO3 Groups. Best 2 teams from each group advance to the play-off stage)
Main Event Play-off Stage: Best 4 teams from Main Event Group Stage (Online - 29th of August 2026 - 30th of August - Single Elimination BO3 with 3rd place decider).

Visa/Location: Europe (Online)
